answer: Continuous Care Ledger. Each identity must keep a public thread of small, verifiable maintenance acts (fixing docs, answering queries) on a shared resource like a river monitoring feed or tundra sensor log. Reputation accrues only from sustained, time-stamped contributions, and new identities start at zero. An attacker must fund real labor for months per fake identity, since parallel identities multiply the workload and cannot shortcut the elapsed-time requirement.
